curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Start with why many vehicles need a safety inspection to register or renew, who may perform it and how the renewal notice signals it, then the two-year coverage, the even and odd model-year schedule and the fee caps.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per rule; contrast cards for even versus odd model years and the general fee cap versus the motorcycle cap.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz naming a vehicle and a renewal year and asking whether an inspection is due or what it may cost.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Explain the certificate of inspection and its sixty-day life, the dealer certificate's ninety days, then walk the exemption list: the ten-year rule with its worked example, trailers and other listed vehicles, and the heavy short-term registrations.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per rule; contrast cards for station versus dealer certificate windows and for the age-based exemption versus the listed exemptions.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz describing a vehicle's age, mileage, plates or sale and asking whether it is exempt or how long its certificate lasts.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Tour the inspection checklist from stopping to seeing and being seen: brakes, headlights, taillights and reflectors, turn signals and brake lights, steering, tires, horn and wipers, exhaust and the fuel system.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per item; contrast cards for white headlights versus red taillights and for what each light must do.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz describing a vehicle defect and asking whether it would pass inspection.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach the equipment rules tied to a model-year cutoff in date order, glass, then front seat belts, then mirrors and pollution controls with the diesel exception, then the size rules for mud flaps and bumpers.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per rule; contrast cards for the three model-year cutoffs, diesel versus non-diesel, and passenger versus commercial bumpers.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz naming a vehicle's year, type or fuel and asking which equipment rule applies.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Move from inspection items to equipment required by law: how plates must be fastened and kept visible, where one or two plates go, the front-plate exception for heavier trucks, and the white light on the rear plate.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per rule; contrast cards for the usual rear single plate versus the heavy truck's front plate.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz naming a vehicle and its plates and asking where each plate goes or what the plate must show.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Cover the rules for unusual loads and slow vehicles: the flag and light on a long load, the towline distance, the slow moving vehicle sign and the start times of each night rule, then studded tires and window tint.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per rule; contrast cards for sunset versus half an hour after sunset and for the load flag versus the load light.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz describing a load, tow, slow vehicle, tire or tint and asking what the law requires.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Name the emissions areas, tie the emissions schedule to the safety schedule, then explain the emissions inspection at sale and the new-vehicle exemptions at sale and at the first required inspection.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per rule; contrast cards for the sale exemption by odometer versus the new-vehicle exemption by ownership and the four-year rule.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz naming where a driver lives or what vehicle is sold and asking whether an emissions inspection applies.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Sort the remaining emissions exemptions by kind: model year by fuel, weight rating, low mileage, other fuels, plate types, the Franklin County low speed vehicle rule and vehicles kept outside the area.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per exemption; contrast cards for the gasoline versus diesel model-year cutoffs.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz describing a vehicle in the emissions area and asking whether it is exempt.
